title: Ahab and Jehoshaphat at Ramoth in Gilead
description: Israelite King Ahab and Judahite King Jehoshaphat plan a campaign against Ramoth in Gilead. Despite the warning from the prophet Michah, who reveals a lying spirit in the mouths of the other prophets, they go to war. Ahab disguises himself but is struck by an arrow at random and dies, just as the Lord had foretold.
